title: Find the Perimeter of Real Objects in Metres

instruction.text: Work out the correct length for each side of the pool and fill in the gaps. The pool is a rectangle.

hint.text: Rectangles have two pairs of equal sides.

instruction.text: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the pool? Select the correct answer.
instruction.sound: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the pool? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: Work out each sum to find the total perimeter of the pool.
What is the perimeter of the pool? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the pool is 74 metres.

instruction.sound: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the garden? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: Work out each sum to find the total perimeter of the garden.
What is the perimeter of the garden? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the garden is 32 metres.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: Work out each sum to find the total perimeter of the football pitch.
What is the perimeter of the football pitch? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the football pitch is 270 metres.
